verdict.rationale: Baseten documents official first-party CLIs. Its own docs show `baseten model push` for shipping models and a one-command checkpoint deploy, and the official Truss repo shows `uvx truss push` building and deploying containers. A Baseten Switch CLI reference routes Claude Code or Codex CLI to Model APIs, which ties the CLI to agent workflows. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use, and evidence of agent-friendly CLI ergonomics such as machine-readable output or a non-interactive mode.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: then run `baseten model push` to ship it
